description: This file defines the UserViewsData class which extends EntityViewsData to provide view configurations for the user entity type in Drupal. It includes methods for retrieving view data, configuring filters, relationships, and access controls specific to user data.

classes.name: UserViewsData
classes.description: Provides view data configurations for the user entity type in Drupal.

methods.name: getViewsData
methods.description: Returns an array of view data configurations for the user entity, including filters, relationships, and access controls.
